defaults.json: one output.schema.json envelope on stdout; no prose or terminal control
defaults.cancellation: first SIGINT cancels the current operation; terminal state is restored

commands.name: login
commands.mutation: create client session after approval
commands.tty: browser/device approval; non-TTY prints verification URL and code
commands.retry: poll only at server interval; safe pending polls

commands.name: logout
commands.mutation: revoke current CLI session family
commands.confirmation: none; scope is printed before mutation

commands.name: auth status
commands.mutation: none
commands.stdout: account, issuer, client label, expiry, state

commands.name: auth switch
commands.mutation: replace active issuer/account profile after approval

commands.name: create
commands.mutation: create billable hosted environment
commands.tty: yes unless all required flags and --yes
commands.confirmation: required with server-provided immediate and renewal price

commands.name: environment list
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: connect
commands.mutation: may safely resume environment; terminal input is separate uncertain-write domain
commands.retry: bounded readiness/reconnect; never replay uncertain input

commands.name: session list
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: session rename
commands.mutation: rename non-default session

commands.name: session close
commands.mutation: terminate one session process, or every open session process with --all, while retaining session identities and history
commands.confirmation: --all shows the resolved environment and open-session count before requiring --yes
commands.retry: single close keeps its operation id; --all re-lists and closes only sessions still open
commands.stdout: closed session or count and retained-history notice

commands.name: session delete
commands.mutation: delete closed non-default session and retained history

commands.name: preview list
commands.mutation: none
commands.stdout: active previews with project, machine, user, URL, and readiness context

commands.name: preview create
commands.mutation: register one public preview and launch one bounded machine runner
commands.confirmation: --public acknowledges that anyone with the URL can access the application
commands.retry: retry with the same stable name after inspecting active previews
commands.idempotency: machine, environment, and stable preview name
commands.stdout: public URL, machine, state, and expiry

commands.name: preview revoke
commands.mutation: revoke one owned active preview and remove its public route
commands.confirmation: required after preview and environment display

commands.name: previews revoke
commands.mutation: revoke every owned active preview in one resolved environment and remove their public routes
commands.confirmation: resolved environment and active-preview count are shown before --yes
commands.retry: re-list previews and revoke only previews still active

commands.name: machine add
commands.mutation: create expiring BYOD pairing request

commands.name: machine list
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: machine availability
commands.mutation: persist desired machine sleep availability
commands.confirmation: --yes required for keep-awake after resolved target display
commands.retry: brief observation poll then automatic helper reconciliation
commands.idempotency: idempotency key plus expected desired version
commands.stdout: desired and observed availability with applied or durably pending outcome

commands.name: machine revoke
commands.mutation: revoke machine/helper/connector descendants

commands.name: config assign
commands.mutation: assign one repository and optionally enable BYOD sync
commands.confirmation: current warning revision required for BYOD

commands.name: config unassign
commands.mutation: revoke assignment and queued helper work

commands.name: config show
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: config path
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: send
commands.mutation: create and publish one addressed transfer batch
commands.confirmation: resolved destination is printed before source files are opened
commands.retry: same batch and operation IDs with authoritative offset recovery
commands.stdout: transfer manifests and Paperboat Inbox outcomes

commands.name: transfer destination
commands.mutation: read, set, or clear a user or session destination default
commands.confirmation: resolved machine is displayed before mutation
commands.idempotency: user or terminal session plus machine ID

commands.name: transfer destination set
commands.mutation: set the user default transfer destination
commands.confirmation: resolved machine is displayed before mutation

commands.name: transfer destination clear
commands.mutation: clear the user default transfer destination

commands.name: transfer list
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: transfer status
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: transfer cancel
commands.mutation: cancel the complete transfer batch and remove incomplete content
commands.confirmation: explicit transfer ID and route target

commands.name: setup
commands.mutation: create or update this machine registration and renewable control authority
commands.idempotency: stable machine key and installation generation
commands.stdout: machine identity, roles, and inbox path

commands.name: pair
commands.mutation: add the host role and install the machine host service
commands.confirmation: dashboard approval binds the machine key and workspace
commands.idempotency: pairing grant and stable machine key
commands.stdout: paired machine and host service state

commands.name: unpair
commands.mutation: remove the host role and stop the host service
commands.retry: idempotent role removal and service stop

commands.name: uninstall
commands.mutation: remove all local Paperboat services, binaries, credentials, configuration, and runtime state while preserving the Paperboat Inbox
commands.confirmation: type UNINSTALL PAPERBOAT, then the exact machine hostname

commands.name: inbox path
commands.mutation: none

commands.name: inbox set
commands.mutation: set this machine's validated Paperboat Inbox path

commands.name: inbox reset
commands.mutation: reset this machine's Inbox to the platform default without moving files

commands.name: doctor
commands.mutation: read-only probes; upload probe uses validation without retained file
commands.stdout: redacted check results and correlation ids
